subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of 1Hz sensor telemetry, physical-boundary validation, out-of-order reconciliation, append-only recording and windowed stream broadcasting
subdomain.why_distinct: Own rules (sensor metric boundaries, 60s reorder window, backpressure, append-only revisions), own language and own change cadence; it is the PulseStream Engine differentiator within the endurance analytics platform

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke)
Transmission unit received from an edge device carrying one or more Telemetry Samples
t_device: device-generated epoch timestamp; the ordering authority
t_ingress: arrival time at the engine; never used for ordering
60-second tolerance within which delayed packets are re-indexed chronologically
Demand-driven flow control that handles burst loads without blocking
Physical physiological/mechanical limit range for a metric (e.g. HR 30-240 BPM, Power 0-2500W, Cadence 0-220 RPM, swim pace >45 s/100m)
Status flag tagged on a sample violating a Sensor Metric Boundary; payload is retained
Newly appended record that corrects or backfills earlier data without altering it

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Stream Intake
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept raw 1Hz packets under backpressure, validate samples against sensor metric boundaries, reorder late packets by device timestamp, and broadcast windowed validated telemetry downstream
invariants: Every sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary before downstream propagation; invalid samples are flagged VALIDATION_FAILED, never dropped
Packets delayed up to 60 seconds are ordered by t_device, not t_ingress
Ingestion applies backpressure and performs no blocking I/O on thread pools
source_of_truth: Validation status of a Telemetry Sample

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Event Ledger
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Durably record telemetry as an append-only event history, adding revisions for corrections and backfills
invariants: Raw time-series records are strictly append-only; corrections and backfills append new event revisions
source_of_truth: Raw telemetry record history and revisions

assumptions.item: Append-only storage is split into its own context from intake because it has a distinct invariant and source of truth
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: If merged, a single context would own both flow and history

assumptions.item: Downstream consumers of broadcast events and the analytics platform are not described
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Consumer contexts are external; only publish side is modeled

assumptions.item: Whether backfilled frames beyond the 60s window are rejected or accepted as revisions is unspecified
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could shift late-data ownership between Intake and Ledger

assumptions.item: Device identity/authentication and athlete/session ownership are not specified
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: May require a separate device/session context
